lessons: The unit coverage gate failed: chupa/retro.py has 11.96% unit-test coverage and test-gate.toml requires 12. The gate says to add unit tests, but the Scope fence names no tests/unit file and test-gate.toml is out of bounds. The ticket must fence a tests/unit test file before a retry can pass.

Once a tests/unit file is fenced, add a unit test that calls chupa/retro.py::measurements on journal events built in memory. It must cover the five new kind branches so retro.py's unit coverage stays at or above 12, without touching test-gate.toml.
Keep the rest of the earlier diff. The full ./dev.py test run passed with 3162 tests and all three verification commands passed. Only the unit covgate on the rebased candidate failed.
Keep the reject fixture's terminal state from also firing gate-failure, as the earlier dead end found. The Definition of rejected forbids changing an existing kind's count for the same journal.
